# Exemplary Carpentry Service

> Finish carpentry, flooring, cabinet installation, drywall and painting, and hardscaping in Goose Creek, SC. 10 years of local Lowcountry craftsmanship for homeowners, property managers, and real estate investors.

## Services

- Finish carpentry: baseboards and shoe molding, crown molding, door and window casing, wainscoting and board-and-batten, cabinet installation, bathroom vanities, custom cabinet build, hardware and trim-out
- Flooring: luxury vinyl plank installation, hardwood installation, subfloor repair and leveling
- Drywall and painting: drywall hanging and finishing, interior painting, exterior painting, cabinet painting, cabinet refinishing
- Outdoor construction and hardscaping: hardscaping and pavers, driveway construction, walkway
